name: zerothird
description: zerothird is a Vienna-based company developing entanglement-based quantum key distribution (eQKD) systems for enterprise security. The technology traces its lineage to Nobel Prize-winning quantum entanglement research. Products include a Key-as-a-Service (KaaS) platform, eQKD systems, and quantum photon source and detector hardware. In February 2026, zerothird launched a live quantum-secure banking pilot with Erste Group and A1 Telekom in Vienna.

news.title: zerothird and Erste Group launch live quantum-secure banking pilot with A1 Telekom in Vienna
news.excerpt: Erste Group, zerothird, and A1 Telekom launched Austria's first live entanglement-based QKD deployment for banking in February 2026. The pilot uses zerothird's eQKD system to secure communications between Erste Group branches, demonstrating the first operational deployment of quantum-secure encryption in European retail banking.
